query: SELECT DISTINCT mm.media_id, mm.content_type, mm.file_name, mm.size, mm.uploader_user_id, mm.created_ts, mm.last_accessed_at, mm.quarantine_status FROM room_events re INNER JOIN media_metadata mm ON mm.media_id = SPLIT_PART(SUBSTRING(re.content->>'url' FROM 7), '/', 2) WHERE re.room_id = $1 AND re.content->>'url' LIKE 'mxc://%%' AND mm.content_type IS NOT NULL AND (($2::BIGINT IS NULL AND $3::TEXT IS NULL) OR mm.created_ts < $2 OR (mm.created_ts = $2 AND mm.media_id < $3)) ORDER BY mm.created_ts DESC, mm.media_id DESC LIMIT $4
